Dina Bass / Bloomberg :

ClickHouse, a Snowflake challenger that offers an OLAP database management system, raised $400M led by Dragoneer at a $15B valuation, up from $6.35B in May 2025   —  Dragoneer is leading a $400 million funding round for the startup.  —  Database technology startup ClickHouse Inc …
